scope: gate-shaping production scripts under scripts/ + their hermetic tests under tests/ (avoided lava-api-go + feature/core per wave assignment)
protocol: CLAUDE.md Seventh-Law clause-5 + §6.N.2 mutation-rehearsal: pick gate-shaping file -> apply deliberate mutation that should flip the gate verdict -> run gate + hermetic test -> if verdict unchanged it is a bluff -> classify/fix -> revert byte-identical

targets.gate: §6.X emulator-runner-tag (CM clause-c: attestation MUST declare runner: containers-submodule)
targets.mutation: Broadened RUNNER_OK regex from the exact 'runner: containers-submodule' pattern to bare 'runner' — would WRONGLY accept a 'runner: host-direct' attestation (a §6.X / §6.AH violation).
targets.observed: Hermetic test test_host_direct_runner_fails FLIPPED to FAIL: 'expected exit 1, got 0'. Direct malformed-fixture run (markers + no runner tag) correctly rejected (exit 1); correct-tag fixture accepted (exit 0).
targets.classification: none — gate genuinely enforces the containers-submodule runner tag and rejects host-direct + tagless attestations

targets.gate: CM-WORKABLE-ITEMS-SYNC (§11.4.93/95: DB validate + DB<->Markdown diff + DB git-tracked)
targets.mutation_a: Inverted clause-3 condition (removed '!' on git ls-files --error-unmatch) — incidentally caught by the existing positive case (rejected the real tracked DB), but for the WRONG reason.
targets.mutation_b: DELETED clause 3 entirely (the §11.4.95 DB-tracked assertion, lines ~47-51). An UNTRACKED SSoT DB would then ship silently.
targets.observed_b: OLD hermetic test STILL reported 'PASS: CM-WORKABLE-ITEMS-SYNC gate is falsifiable' with clause 3 removed — the test NEVER exercised the git-tracking branch (its own comment hand-waved 'conceptually untracked is covered').
targets.classification: uncovered gate branch — the §11.4.95 DB-tracked clause could be silently dropped and CI stays green
targets.fix: ADDITIVE: gate now honors LAVA_WORKABLE_ITEMS_DB/ISSUES/FIXED env overrides (defaults unchanged, consistent with sibling gates' hermetic-injection pattern). Added a clause-3 falsifiability sub-test that builds a temp git repo with a tracked Markdown pair + an UNTRACKED fixture DB, points the gate at it, and asserts rejection.
targets.fix_proof: After fix, deleting clause 3 (mutation_b) now makes the augmented test FAIL with 'gate accepted an UNTRACKED DB (clause-3 §11.4.95 not enforced)'; post-revert PASS.
targets.reverted: yes — both gate mutations reverted byte-identical; the additive override + sub-test are the kept fix

targets.mutation: Dropped 'probably' from the forbidden_guess_words alternation — the gate would then WRONGLY pass a description containing 'probably'.
targets.observed: Hermetic test test_forbidden_word_rejected FLIPPED to FAIL: 'rc=0 out=§11.4.6 no-guessing vocabulary gate clean.'
targets.classification: none — gate genuinely enforces the forbidden-vocabulary list; UNCONFIRMED/PENDING_FORENSICS whitelist + forensic-anchor exemption also verified by the test suite

incidental_finding_out_of_scope.observation: check-constitution.sh exits 1 at PRISTINE HEAD (reproduced with all my edits stashed) because scan-no-hardcoded-ipv4.sh flags the binary docs/workable_items.db ('Binary file ... matches') for the loopback literal 127.0.0.1 embedded in a workable-item description. The scan's documented loopback exemption (127.0.0.0/8) operates on TEXT lines and does NOT apply to binary-file grep matches — so the loopback exemption is a PARTIAL BLUFF for binary-tracked files.
incidental_finding_out_of_scope.status: PRE-EXISTING, not introduced by this hunt; out of this wave's assigned 3 picks and touches the SSoT DB content. NOT fixed here to avoid scope collision; surfaced for an LVA item.
incidental_finding_out_of_scope.evidence: git stash of my 2 edits + check-constitution.sh => still EXIT 1 with identical 'Binary file docs/workable_items.db matches' message.
